new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in Dubai?
A private chef costs from AED 700 per person, quoted by guest count, menu and service level. Send your date and headcount for an itemised, no-obligation quote.
Is 1000 AED enough for food in Dubai?

It depends whether that is your budget per head or for the whole table. As a per-person figure it is comfortable: a private chef is AED 750 to AED 1,000 a head for six guests and AED 700 to AED 950 for ten, so AED 1,000 per person buys a full plated dinner with service. As a total for an event, AED 1,000 is roughly one cover with a private chef — or a ten-guest working-lunch buffet at AED 90 a head, which clears our AED 900 minimum order with a little to spare. Tell us which of the two you mean and we will quote to it honestly.
How much does a private chef cost per day?

There is no day rate. A chef is priced per person per meal, so a day is costed as the meals it contains — lunch and dinner for six at AED 750 to AED 1,000 a head each, with the second service usually lower because the shopping and setup are already done.
Can I hire a live-in or full-time private chef?

Not through us. MyCHEF prices by the event, not by the month, so we do not quote a salary for a live-in cook or place full-time household staff — that is a domestic staffing agency's job, and we would rather point you there than sell you something adjacent. The closest thing we run is weekly meal prep from AED 1,898 a week, and part-time cooking at home is quoted the same way, by the sessions you want.
What is included in the private chef price?
Included are menu design, a vetted chef, service staff where needed, all ingredients, setup and full cleanup — costed line by line so nothing hides in the small print.
Are there affordable private chef options in Dubai?
Affordable options start with the Signature menu from AED 750 per person, and larger groups lower the per-head rate, so a shared dinner can cost less per guest than an intimate one.
How do I hire a private chef near me?
Hiring is quick: share your date, guest count and venue, and myCHEF matches a vetted chef near you, returning an itemised proposal usually within one business day.
Do you offer corporate and party catering prices?
Yes — corporate events and private parties are quoted to the format, with retainers available for companies that entertain regularly and package prices for one-off celebrations.
Which private chef package offers the most value?
Value depends on your table, but the Family Feast from AED 2,400 suits home gatherings, while the Full Experience from AED 5,500 covers a complete luxury evening with full service.
Can I see a menu before booking?
Yes — you approve the full menu and price before anything is confirmed, and the chef will tailor courses to your tastes, dietary needs and occasion.
For private chef cost, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

What we do run for a household that wants a chef in the kitchen every week is weekly meal prep. A chef plans the menu, shops, cooks and stocks your fridge on a set schedule: from AED 1,898 a week for the Lite plan and AED 2,698 a week for the Standard one. Divide either figure across the week and it is the closest thing on this site to a daily cost for a chef at home, without the visa, the salary, the accommodation or the responsibility of being an employer. Households that entertain a few times a month tend to combine the two — meal prep for the ordinary weeks, a booked private chef for the evenings that matter.

add_block.new_heading: What affects your private chef price
new_paragraphs: Five things move a private chef price up or down, and knowing them helps you plan an affordable evening without cutting the parts that matter. First, guest count: more covers usually mean a lower per-person rate as the fixed costs spread out. Second, menu tier and ingredients — a truffle-and-wagyu tasting costs more than a rustic family feast. Third, service level: a single chef plating quietly is lighter on the bill than a full brigade with servers and a bar. Fourth, venue and logistics — a yacht galley or a desert setup needs more planning than a fitted home kitchen. Fifth, timing: peak dates around New Year and Eid book out fast and sit at the top of the range. Share these details and we return an honest, itemised quote instead of a padded one you have to argue down.
